scripts.build:web: nix-shell ../shell.nix --run 'node ../AgentUp.DesignSystem/scripts/build.mjs --check && npm --prefix ../AgentUp.AgentAuth run build && npm --prefix ../AgentUp.ServerClient install --no-audit --no-fund && npm --prefix ../AgentUp.Chat install --no-audit --no-fund && node scripts/export-web.mjs'
